# Smudge

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P11](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Smudge Coat  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Smudge is a gangly, skinny, and scruffy-looking stray who is far past kittenhood. The creature possesses a sparse, wet, and unattractive coat.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P13](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0013)_

## Personality

Smudge possesses an inherently combative nature. However, except for issues regarding his lack of ears, he is otherwise described as the sweetest cat anywhere.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), [v3 ch.Opens P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)_

## Traits

## History

Smudge was claimed by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) as her cat after [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) unsuccessfully attempted to kill him. Following initial skirmishes with Aunt Euphemia's arriving cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), Smudge ultimately became close companions with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). Later, during an early visit from [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) Lisle's family, the household cats jumped on Mrs. Lisle during an awkward gathering.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--smudge.md)

[Joseph](../character/joseph.md) is one of Aunt Euphemia's cats who joins the household at Tabby's Place alongside Smudge, Nell's cat. Although the animals engage in initial skirmishes when they first meet, they eventually become devoted companions. They share a pillow and spend time grooming each other.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +1 more_
